title: Coppaleen
html_source:
“coppaleen” is Anglicized Irish for
a little horse.

also a character in the play The Colleen Bawn:

Myles na Coppaleen (from the Irish Myles na gcapaillín, “Myles of the ponies”) — poacher and moonshine brewer.
